purpose: Classify the apparent 3154.8 prompt-token/s value in the existing single-V100 1Cat-vLLM 1.2.1 run without rerunning inference.

classification.conclusion: The 3154.8 value is a 10-second logging-bucket rate, not end-to-end cold-prefill throughput. The matching request's client-observed cold prompt rate is 445.76 prompt tokens/s when computed from prompt_tokens/TTFT.
classification.evidence_strength: The 31549-token request divided by vLLM's 10-second default log interval is 3154.9 tokens/s, within 0.1 tokens/s of the logged 3154.8. The request trace independently records a 70.7765-second TTFT.
limitations: The cold request includes first-inference Triton JIT warnings, so 445.76 tokens/s is not a warmed cache-miss ceiling.
Later requests have substantial prefix-cache reuse and cannot be used as full-prompt cold-prefill measurements.
This artifact is TP1 on one V100, not a dual-V100 TP2 result.
Do not compare this logger bucket value with FastLLM prompt_tokens/TTFT figures.

direct_comparison_policy.accepted_prefill_rate_formula: request.prompt_tokens / request.ttft_seconds for a verified cache miss after route warmup
required_matching_fields: model architecture and active parameter count
